ValidationRule.description: A validation rule will prevent Sellers from modifying Deal Type once the Opportunity has reached or progressed beyond Negotiation.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(Bypass_Validation__c), ISCHANGED(Type), NOT($Permission.Edit_Deal_Type_After_Negotiation), OR( ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Negotiation"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Booking Verification"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Setup"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Closed Won"), ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Closed Lost") ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Deal Type cannot be modified after the Opportunity enters Negotiation. Contact an authorized operational team if a correction is required.
